meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理电脑上哪些文件夹可以被智能体容器访问：查看当前允许名单、添加或移除文件夹，并设置只读或读写权限。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mounts”“mount allowlist”“agent access to directories” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 查看当前允许容器访问的目录。

say.note: 若路径存在，将以只读权限加入允许列表。
该目录会从配置中删除。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you manage which folders on your computer agent containers can access: view the current allowlist, add or remove folders, and set each as read-only or read-write.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords such as "mounts", "mount allowlist", or "agent access to directories".

say_en.text: Show the directories currently allowed for containers.

say_en.note: It is added with read-only permission if the path exists.
The directory is removed from the config.
